title: Connected Workspaces
subtitle: The workspaces this machine has joined, with their agents and activity
emptyNone: A workspace is where you and your agents work together. Create one on the web, after signing in, then connect an agent to it with `agn connect`.

toast.removedWarning: Removed "{{name}}" on this device, but the workspace could not be reached: {{message}}
toast.renamedWorkspace: Renamed to "{{name}}" for everyone in the workspace

remove.title: Remove "{{name}}"?
remove.description: This device is disconnected from the workspace and its local record is deleted. The workspace itself, its channels, and its other members are untouched.
remove.descriptionRemote: Deleted for every member — channels, history and connected devices go with it. No undo in the app.

effects.agents: Agents in this workspace leave it and are unbound on this device.
effects.local: The workspace disappears from this computer until an agent connects to it again.

remove.alsoDelete: Delete the workspace on the server too — all members
remove.alsoDeleteWarning: Everyone loses access immediately. Only an admin restoring the record by hand can undo it.

card.noAgents: No agent is connected to this workspace
card.deviceLinked: No agent is bound here yet — install one on this device from the workspace.
card.trendTruncated: Counted from the most recent messages only; earlier days may read low
card.deviceBadgeHint: This machine is paired to this workspace as a node — agents can be installed and run on it from there.
card.revokedTitle: This device was removed from the workspace
card.revokedBody: The workspace revoked this pairing, so the agents here can no longer connect.

rename.title: Rename workspace
rename.label: Display name
rename.hint: Shown on this machine only. The slug ({{slug}}) and the workspace’s own name are unchanged.
rename.hintRemote: The workspace’s own name. The slug ({{slug}}) and existing links are unchanged.
rename.applyRemote: Rename it on the server too — all members
rename.remoteWarningBody: Only the displayed name changes; members, links, agents and history are unaffected.

emptyNoFilterMatch: Every workspace you have is in another state right now.

qrcode.dialogDescription: Scan to open {{name}} on another device.
qrcode.clickToCopy: Click the code to copy the link
qrcode.unavailable: This workspace has no shareable link. Open it in the browser on the other device and sign in there.
